verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms that Netlify offers serverless functions ('Build APIs with serverless functions', 'zero-config Lambda functions'). Nothing in the pack states that these functions run unmodified Node.js code or arbitrary npm packages rather than a restricted runtime subset. Offering functions is adjacent to the story's actual subject, Node.js and npm runtime compatibility, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset
